Frequently Asked Questions

Premium boats add larger rooms, a more spacious deck and a higher level of onboard service. The exact inclusions are shown on each boat’s detail page.
Private is best for families, couples and celebrations. Sharing is a more social way to enjoy the same waterway at a lighter price.
Overnight cruises generally check in at 12:00 PM and return after breakfast at 9:00 AM. Day cruises typically run from late morning to 5:00 PM.
The boat moors in the evening for safety and comfort. You still get a beautiful sunset, dinner on the water and a quiet night onboard.
Your package includes the selected cruise, crew service and the meals listed on the boat page. Add-ons and full-time AC are shown before you enquire.
Most listed houseboats include attached bathrooms. Check the Amenities & Inclusions section of your chosen boat for confirmation.
Room capacity varies by boat. Our team will confirm the most comfortable arrangement for your group before booking.
Yes. Tell us what you have in mind on WhatsApp and we can arrange flowers, cake or a simple celebration setup at an additional cost.

Cruise Route & Schedule

DAY 1 · 12:00 PMDepart from AlleppeyBoard at the jetty, welcome drink served
AFTERNOONPunnamada Lake & Vembanad LakeKerala's largest lake — open water, wide skies
MID-AFTERNOONR Block & C BlockMan-made paddy fields from the lake, cultivation below sea level — a rare sight
LATE AFTERNOONRani · Chithira · MarthandamVillages, islands and narrow canals winding through coconut groves
EVENINGKainakari → KuppapuramBoat docks for the night near the village. Dinner onboard under the stars.
DAY 2 · MORNINGKuppapuram → Meenapally KayalBreakfast onboard, early morning canal life
RETURNPallathuruthy → AlleppeyBack at the jetty by 9:00 AM

Occupancy & Additional Guests

  • Base rates are calculated on single or double occupancy per bedroom.
  • Children up to 5 years of age stay free of charge.
  • Additional guests can be accommodated for an extra charge.

Policies & Guidelines

  • Private accommodation with a dedicated captain and crew
  • Check-in at 12:00 PM; return by 9:00 AM after breakfast
  • Children under 5 stay free; extra guests are confirmed with the team
  • Special routes and celebration setups are available on request
  • Tariff rates are subject to increase during major festivals including Onam, Diwali, Pongal, Vishu, and Bakrid.
  • Peak season rates apply from December 20th to January 10th and will be notably higher.
